summary.name: Itsytv
summary.one_liner: A remote-control app for Apple TV that runs on iPhone, iPad, and Mac (menu bar), sold as a one-time purchase without a subscription.
keywords: mac menu bar apple tv remote
use_cases: control Apple TV from an iPhone
use iPad as a couch remote with app launcher
control playback from the Mac menu bar
type into Apple TV search from a keyboard
manage several Apple TVs in different rooms
look up cast and credits for what is playing
summary.what_it_does: Itsytv provides a touch remote for Apple TV on iPhone, iPad, and Mac. It shows a launcher of installed Apple TV apps that can be reordered by dragging, and the remote slides back into view after an app is launched. When content is playing, it pulls artwork, plot, rating, genre, and cast info and offers full credits with photos. Users can switch between multiple Apple TVs in a tap and it reconnects automatically to the last one used. On iPad it shows the app launcher and remote side by side, and on Mac it lives in the menu bar where it can type into Apple TV search fields.
notable: Remote can be placed on left or right side and repositioned vertically for either hand
Multi-room support for several Apple TVs with automatic reconnection
Menu bar app on Mac that can type into Apple TV search fields
Works with Itsyhome for controlling smart home devices from the menu bar
caveats: Requires iOS 17 or later, iPadOS 17, macOS 14 or later, and tvOS 15 or later on the Apple TV (4th gen or later)
Apple TV and the controlling device must be on the same Wi-Fi network
Pricing is a one-time purchase per the page; the iOS/iPad version is a universal purchase
